name: 2026-11-hosted-embed-screen
stage: 1 of 2: screen on public Loc-Bench tasks; stage 2 (product opt-in, own questions) runs only for a passing model
units: eval.matrix.function_dense.ours: .py top-level functions and class methods, no test paths
score: L2-normalized dot product, stable descending, files_of(ranked)[:200]; fused = eval.matrix.arms.rrf([product, model]); Acc@5 = eval.matrix.function_dense.acc

request.preflight: 2 fixed documents and 1 fixed query; the first variant that the provider accepts is used for all calls
request.abort_on: any other status, or the spend limit of the model

reference.source: private run lb-2026-10-18 results.jsonl (cells product, fn-dense, rrf(product+fn-dense))

gates.complete: a model decides only if at most 2 tasks are incomplete; an incomplete task counts as a miss
gates.net_gain: hits5(rrf(product+model)) - hits5(product) >= 5, that is +0.10 on 50 tasks
gates.sign_test: one-sided exact sign test on the discordant tasks against product, p <= 0.05
gates.winner: among passing models: most rrf hits5, then most model-alone hits5, then lower measured spend
reported_not_gated: model alone against product and fn-dense

not_doing: no tuning, no second dispatch after scored work starts, no product change in stage 1
